summary: Web model identity observation with evidence-confidence ordering, Auto handling, no fabricated backend ids, snapshot dedup by identity fingerprint
implementation: src/shared/model-identity.ts: ModelIdentitySource (NETWORK_METADATA > PAGE_METADATA > UI_SELECTOR > PROVIDER_DECLARED > INFERRED > UNKNOWN) with per-source confidence ceilings; SELF_REPORTED_CONFIDENCE cap (a model's text claim is never high-confidence); ModelExecutionIdentity (provider/surface/selectedModel/declaredModel/observedModelId/mode/versionSource/confidence/observedAt/behaviourEpochId); ModelSnapshot (schemaVersion 1, fingerprint, first/lastObservedAt); modelIdentityFingerprint over stable fields only (timestamps excluded); isAutoSelection/isConcreteModelId; provenanceOf ⇒ OBSERVED / PROVIDER_DECLARED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN

electron/learning/providers/version-resolver.ts: resolveModelIdentity — deterministic best-source selection, Auto treated as a mode (half confidence, no id), observedModelId only from structured metadata, UNKNOWN when nothing observed

electron/learning/providers/model-observer.ts: ModelObserver — collects only legitimately exposed fields (network/page metadata, UI selector, provider declaration, self-report capped, inferred); malformed metadata ignored + reported, never thrown; unobserved() for legacy adapters

electron/learning/providers/model-snapshot.ts: ModelSnapshotRegistry — dedup by identity fingerprint (repeat ⇒ same MS-xxx with advancing lastObservedAt), new observed id ⇒ new snapshot leaving old history intact, durable file, corrupt file degrades learning
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-3.test.ts (14 tests): source trust ordering + confidence ceilings; self-report cannot outrank structure; A13 explicit model recorded w/ provenance; A14 Auto recorded as Auto with no fabricated backend; A15 unobservable ⇒ undefined/UNKNOWN/confidence 0; structured metadata may observe a concrete backend even in Auto; malformed metadata ignored not thrown; A49 legacy adapter identity; A17 snapshot dedup + lastObservedAt advance; A18 new id ⇒ new snapshot, old untouched; A16 one conversation binds three snapshots across turns; fingerprint excludes time; durable restart keeps dedup; corrupt snapshot file degrades without throwing
notes: Addresses A13-A18 and A49. No bypass/jailbreak mechanism is implemented: only fields the host can legitimately read are collected.
